Engine: paradigm. Analyse fusional inflection against stem and ending paradigms.
Engine: compounding. Split and classify compounds.
Engine: root_pattern. Extract consonantal roots and match vocalic and affixal templates.
Engine: affix_chain. Peel ordered affix chains, applying harmony where the language has it.
Engine: logogram. Resolve logograms, heterograms and determinatives to readings.
Engine: syllabary. Map syllabic signs to values and keep every reading of a polyphonous sign.
Engine: vocalisation. Restore vowels the script leaves unwritten, returning every admissible reading.
Engine: abugida. Resolve inherent vowels, conjuncts and vowel signs, through the Romenagri script tables.
Engine: unspaced. Find word boundaries in text the script does not divide into words.
Engine: sign_sequence. Tokenise and count signs of an undeciphered or proto-writing corpus without assigning a language.
